To: Priya Menon <priya.menon@routewell.example>
Subject: RE: FW: Security questionnaire discrepancy - Brazos Freight / Routewell

Priya,

First, please don’t beat yourself up. You made a mistake, but I’m not throwing you under the bus with Greg. I’ll handle that conversation. We need to be straight about what happened, including the fact that our questionnaire library has stale answers and nobody clearly owns it. That’s not all on you.

I also haven’t forgotten you staying on until 9pm in September rebuilding their demo environment when the route import broke. You’ve been great on this account. One copy-paste mistake doesn’t erase that.

I won’t pretend I’m not stressed. This is my biggest deal of the year: $186k ARR, three-year term, and we’ve been working it since February. I already told my wife we’d finally do the Big Bend trip off this commission, so apparently I’ve also committed us to a vacation before getting a signature. But that’s context, not something I’m putting on your shoulders. We’re fixing this together.

Here’s what we need to do:

- Please correct Q14 tonight and send it to me first, not Dana. It needs to accurately state that we have a SOC 2 Type I report issued in April, that the Type II audit window closes January 31, and that the report is expected by March.
- I talked to Marcus. He’s available Thursday at 2 for a call with Dana and their legal team. Please join that call too so we can work through this together.
- Marcus also confirmed we can provide a bridge letter from the auditor. We should have him explain exactly what it covers rather than imply it satisfies their Type II requirement.

I think this is fixable if we’re honest and move quickly. Dana seems strict but fair, and we need to give her accurate information and a concrete path forward—not another optimistic answer.

Send me the correction tonight and we’ll take it from there. I’ve got Greg.

Jordan
